body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> ASUS revealed 'Eee Keyboard' equipped with a 5-inch touch screen and 32GB SSD at the company's official press conference during CES 2009 in Las Vegas.
(Picture: Jerry Shen, CEO of ASUS demonstrated the 'Eee Keyboard')

As a wireless media center for multimedia enjoyment, this fully functional Eee Keyboard enables users to turn their TV into a PC to share with others. Featuring high-speed wireless HDMI connection for indoor mobility and more comfortable touch with reactive keypad, it also supports Intel Atom N270/N330 CPU, 1GB DDR2 memory, WiFi((802.11n & Bluetooth V2.0) network and various AV ports.
